Elena M.: Heads up — PM-201 postmortem follow-up. A few remediation items are past their due dates and Im doing a quick chase-down. Please post a one-line status or blocker. Items: 
- Theo K.: add long-term mitigation design doc (due 2026-03-01) 
- Priya N.: automate alerting for threshold X (due 2026-03-03) 
- Carlos G.: rotate deploy keys + update CI workflows (due 2026-02-28) 
If I don't see updates by 6pm PT I'll escalate to Eng SRE + your managers.

Theo K.: Sorry, slipping on the design doc. Draft is 60% done — stalled on validation data shapes. Need access to archived traces (log-retention) to finish. Filed INF-501 to get trace export.

Priya N.: Alerting PR open: https://git.internal/alerts/pulls/192. Tests failing in staging due to flaky metric ingestion. Looking into root cause now.

eng-sre-bot: INF-501 created and assigned to infra-team. Estimated ETA: 24h.

Carlos G.: I rotated keys last week for the main service but missed the legacy deploys. Will complete legacy workflows tonight and post CI run ID.

Elena M.: Thanks. Please paste the PR link or ticket when you have it. Quick ask: if INF-501 isn't resolved by tomorrow morning, I will escalate.

Theo K.: INF-501 updated: infra exported traces to /mnt/exports/pm201/ — I have access now. Will finish doc and send PR by EOD tomorrow.

Priya N.: Found ingestion bug: agent batcher drops metrics when index > 128. Fix in flight, PR ready for review: https://git.internal/alerts/pulls/193. Requesting quick review from @eng-sre.

devops-bot: CI Run 9876 started for alerts/pulls/193. Status: running.

Carlos G.: Legacy workflows updated. CI run 4456 completed: all checks green. Link: https://ci.internal/runs/4456. Marking my item as done.

eng-sre-bot: @Priya N. requested review. Paging on-call: @eng-sre to review PR 193.

Theo K.: PR opened for design doc: https://git.internal/pm-design/pulls/17. Adds high-level mitigation, validation steps, and rollout plan.

Priya N.: CI run 9876 passed after the fix. Alerts PR merged. Alerting automation now firing in staging.

Elena M.: Great work — Carlos and Priya, marking your items resolved. Theo, will check PR and aim to merge tomorrow morning. Once merged, I'll close PM-201 action tracker.

Elena M.: Update 2026-03-05 09:12 PT  PR for Theo merged, alerts verified in prod, CI keys rotation confirmed. Closing PM-201 remediation items. If anything regresses, reopen the tracker or ping me directly. :white_check_mark:
